en.name: Rice vinegar
en.summary: Rice vinegar is a mild, clean-tasting brewed vinegar, sold plain or seasoned with sugar and salt for sushi rice. Unopened it keeps about 2 years in the cupboard; opened, about 12 months. Both are quality figures — vinegar is an acid and does not need refrigeration at all.
en.pantry: A cool dark cupboard, capped, is all it needs: about 2 years unopened from purchase and about 12 months once opened. Vinegar is one of the barrier foods that requires no refrigeration, so these numbers are about flavour rather than safety. A cloudy haze or a gelatinous blob — a vinegar 'mother' — in an old bottle is harmless; strain it out or ignore it. Seasoned or sushi vinegar has sugar and salt added and will taste tired sooner than the plain kind, so buy it in the size you will use.
en.fridge: Rice vinegar does not need refrigeration and gains nothing measurable from it. If your kitchen is hot and a bottle will sit a long time, the fridge slows the flavour fading, but a tight cap and a dark cupboard do most of that work already. Seasoned vinegar is the one worth refrigerating if you use it rarely, because the sugar makes it the more fragile of the two. Never decant vinegar into a bare metal container.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for rice vinegar and no reason to freeze it. It is an acidic liquid that preserves itself indefinitely on a shelf, and freezing only unsettles the sediment. Keep the freezer for foods that genuinely need it.
spoilage: Mould around the neck or cap, usually in dried residue
A flat, dusty taste with none of the original clean sharpness — old rather than unsafe
Solid matter floating beyond the expected haze or mother
A metallic taste after storage in a bare metal container
tips: Cap it tightly and keep it out of sunlight.
Check the label before pickling — many Japanese and Chinese rice vinegars are weaker than the 5 percent acidity a tested pickling recipe assumes.
Buy seasoned vinegar in small bottles; the sugar makes it fade sooner.
Strain out the mother if it bothers you, or leave it — it is harmless.

faq.q: Does rice vinegar need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No. A cool dark cupboard is all it needs. Refrigeration slows flavour loss slightly but adds nothing to safety.

faq.q: How long does rice vinegar last after opening?
faq.a: About 12 months capped in a cupboard. Unopened, about 2 years. Both are quality figures.

faq.q: Can you use rice vinegar for pickling?
faq.a: Check the label first. Pickling recipes assume vinegar of 5 percent acidity for safety, and many rice vinegars are weaker than that.

faq.q: What is the cloudy blob in my rice vinegar?
faq.a: A vinegar mother — a harmless cellulose mat formed by the vinegar bacteria. Strain it out or ignore it.

zh.name: 米醋
zh.summary: 米醋是溫和乾淨的釀造醋，有純米醋，也有加糖加鹽調成的壽司醋。未開封放櫥櫃大約 2 年；開封後大約 12 個月。這兩個都是風味數字——醋本身就是酸，根本不需要冷藏。
zh.pantry: 陰涼避光的櫥櫃、蓋緊，這就是它全部的需求：未開封從購買日起算大約 2 年，開封後大約 12 個月。醋是不需要冷藏的屏障型食品之一，所以這些數字講的是風味而不是安全。放久的瓶子出現霧狀混濁或一團膠狀的「醋母」都是無害的，濾掉或不理它都可以。調味過的壽司醋加了糖和鹽，會比純米醋更早走味，所以請買用得完的容量。
zh.fridge: 米醋不需要冷藏，冷藏也得不到可衡量的好處。如果廚房很熱、某一瓶又會擱很久，冷藏可以減緩風味流失，但蓋緊和避光其實已經完成了大部分的工作。真的值得冷藏的是很少用的壽司醋，因為含糖讓它成為兩者中比較脆弱的那個。醋絕對不要倒進裸露的金屬容器。
zh.freezer: 米醋沒有冷凍期限，也沒有冷凍的理由。它是能在架上無限期自我保存的酸性液體，冷凍只會把沉澱攪起來。冷凍庫留給真正需要的食材。
spoilage: 瓶口或瓶蓋的乾漬處長霉
喝起來扁平無味、完全沒有原本乾淨的酸勁——那是老了，不是不安全
除了預期的霧狀或醋母之外，還有其他固體漂浮物
曾放在裸露金屬容器中，現在帶金屬味
tips: 要醃漬前先看標示——許多日式和中式米醋的酸度低於經驗證配方預設的 5%。
壽司醋請買小瓶；糖讓它更早走味。
介意醋母就濾掉，不介意就留著，它無害。

faq.a: 不用。陰涼避光的櫥櫃就夠了。冷藏能稍微減緩風味流失，但對安全沒有加分。

faq.q: 米醋開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊放櫥櫃大約 12 個月。未開封大約 2 年。兩者都是風味數字。

faq.q: 米醋可以拿來醃漬保存嗎？
faq.a: 請先看標示。醃漬配方為了安全預設 5% 酸度，而許多米醋低於這個數值。

faq.q: 米醋裡那團霧狀的東西是什麼？
faq.a: 那是醋母，醋酸菌形成的纖維素膜，無害。濾掉或不理它都可以。
